note: Computed by summing the exact usage object (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens) reported on every assistant message across the run's own transcript plus any gap-fill sub-agent it spawned, then pricing each token type at Claude Sonnet 5's published per-token rate. Cache write/read rates use Anthropic's standard published ratios (1.25x and 0.1x of the base input rate) since the model card lists only base input/output pricing. This required reading this session's own subagent transcripts directly -- it is not something the shipped plugin computes on its own for other installs.
